title: त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Damayanti sends Keshini to watch Bahuka. She reports marvels: low doorways rise for him, pots fill with water at his glance, grass bursts into flame, and crushed flowers bloom again in his hands; Damayanti then sends her children to him.
summary.kn: ಬಾಹುಕನನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಲು ದಮಯಂತಿ ಕೇಶಿನಿಯನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ತಗ್ಗಿನ ಬಾಗಿಲು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಎತ್ತರವಾಗುವುದು, ನೋಟದಿಂದಲೇ ಕೊಡ ತುಂಬುವುದು, ಹುಲ್ಲು ಉರಿಯುವುದು, ಹೊಸಕಿದ ಹೂವು ಅವನ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅರಳುವುದು ಎಂಬ ಅದ್ಭುತಗಳನ್ನು ಅವಳು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ದಮಯಂತಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಅವನಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: दमयन्ती केशिनी को बाहुक पर दृष्टि रखने भेजती हैं। वह अद्भुत बातें बताती है: नीचे द्वार उसके लिए ऊँचे हो जाते हैं, उसकी दृष्टि से घड़े भर जाते हैं, घास जल उठती है और मसले फूल उसके हाथों में फिर खिल उठते हैं; तब दमयन्ती अपने बच्चों को उसके पास भेजती हैं।
summary.te: బాహుకుని గమనించడానికి దమయంతి కేశినిని పంపుతుంది. పల్లపు ద్వారాలు అతనికి ఎత్తవుతాయని, చూపుకే కుండలు నిండుతాయని, గడ్డి మండుతుందని, నలిగిన పూలు అతని చేతుల్లో మళ్లీ వికసిస్తాయని ఆమె అద్భుతాలు చెబుతుంది; దమయంతి పిల్లలను అతని వద్దకు పంపుతుంది.
summary.ta: பாஹுகனைக் கவனிக்கத் தமயந்தி கேஶினியை அனுப்புகிறாள். தாழ்ந்த வாயில்கள் அவனுக்காக உயர்வதும், பார்வையிலேயே குடங்கள் நிரம்புவதும், புல் தீப்பற்றுவதும், கசக்கிய மலர்கள் அவன் கையில் மீண்டும் மலர்வதும் என அதிசயங்களை அவள் சொல்ல, தமயந்தி தன் குழந்தைகளை அவனிடம் அனுப்புகிறாள்.
summary.ml: ബാഹുകനെ നിരീക്ഷിക്കാൻ ദമയന്തി കേശിനിയെ അയക്കുന്നു. താഴ്ന്ന വാതിലുകൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തിനായി ഉയരുന്നുവെന്നും ഒരു നോട്ടത്തിൽ കുടങ്ങൾ വെള്ളം നിറയുന്നുവെന്നും പുല്ല് തീ പിടിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും, ഞെരുക്കിയ പൂക്കൾ കയ്യിൽ വീണ്ടും വിരിയുന്നുവെന്നും കേശിനി അത്ഭുതങ്ങൾ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; പിന്നീട് ദമയന്തി മക്കളെ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് അയക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.73; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: बृहदश्व उवाच

meaning.en: Brihadashva said:

verses.text:
दमयन्ती तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भृशं शोकपरायणा ।
शङ्कमाना नलं तं वै केशिनीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, Damayanti, sunk in sorrow and suspecting that this was Nala, spoke to Keshini.

verses.text:
गच्छ केशिनि भूयस्त्वं परीक्षां कुरु बाहुके ।
अब्रुवाणा समीपस्था चरितान्यस्य लक्षय ॥

meaning.en: Go again, Keshini, and test Bahuka. Stay near him without speaking and watch his conduct.

verses.text:
यदा च किंचित्कुर्यात्स कारणं तत्र भामिनि ।
तत्र संचेष्टमानस्य संलक्ष्यं ते विचेष्टितम् ॥

meaning.en: Whenever he does anything for some reason, observe closely how he goes about it.

verses.text:
न चास्य प्रतिबन्धेन देयोऽग्निरपि भामिनि ।
याचते न जलं देयं सम्यगत्वरमाणया ॥

meaning.en: Do not give him fire if he is obstructed, and if he asks for water, do not hand it over hurriedly, but with care.

verses.text:
एतत्सर्वं समीक्ष्य त्वं चरितं मे निवेदय ।
यच्चान्यदपि पश्येथास्तच्चाख्येयं त्वया मम ॥

meaning.en: Observe all this and report his behaviour to me, and tell me anything else you notice too.

verses.text:
दमयन्त्यैवमुक्ता सा जगामाथाशु केशिनी ।
निशाम्य च हयज्ञस्य लिङ्गानि पुनरागमत् ॥

meaning.en: So instructed by Damayanti, Keshini went quickly, and having watched the signs of that horse-expert she came back.

verses.text:
सा तत्सर्वं यथावृत्तं दमयन्त्यै न्यवेदयत् ।
निमित्तं यत्तदा दृष्टं बाहुके दिव्यमानुषम् ॥

meaning.en: She told Damayanti exactly what had happened, the sign she had seen in Bahuka, divine and human together.

verses.text: केशिन्युवाच

meaning.en: Keshini said:

verses.text:
दृढं शुच्युपचारोऽसौ न मया मानुषः क्वचित् ।
दृष्टपूर्वः श्रुतो वापि दमयन्ति तथाविधः ॥

meaning.en: He is strictly clean in his habits. Damayanti, I have never seen or heard of such a man anywhere.

verses.text:
ह्रस्वमासाद्य संचारं नासौ विनमते क्वचित् ।
तं तु दृष्ट्वा यथासङ्गमुत्सर्पति यथासुखम् ।
संकटेऽप्यस्य सुमहद्विवरं जायतेऽधिकम् ॥

meaning.en: At a low doorway he does not stoop; instead the opening rises to suit him. And even in a narrow place a great space opens up for him.

verses.text:
ऋतुपर्णस्य चार्थाय भोजनीयमनेकशः ।
प्रेषितं तत्र राज्ञा च मांसं सुबहु पाशवम् ॥

meaning.en: King Rituparna had sent a great quantity of animal meat there, to be prepared as food many times over.

verses.text:
तस्य प्रक्षालनार्थाय कुम्भस्तत्रोपकल्पितः ।
स तेनावेक्षितः कुम्भः पूर्ण एवाभवत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: A pot had been set out to wash it in, and at Bahuka's glance the pot at once became full.

verses.text:
ततः प्रक्षालनं कृत्वा समधिश्रित्य बाहुकः ।
तृणमुष्टिं समादाय आविध्यैनं समादधत् ॥

meaning.en: Then he washed the meat and set it on the fire, took a handful of straw, twisted it and held it up.

verses.text:
अथ प्रज्वलितस्तत्र सहसा हव्यवाहनः ।
तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताहमिहागता ॥

meaning.en: The fire flared up at once. Seeing that wonder, I was amazed and have come here.

verses.text:
अन्यच्च तस्मिन्सुमहदाश्चर्यं लक्षितं मया ।
यदग्निमपि संस्पृश्य नैव दह्यत्यसौ शुभे ॥

meaning.en: I noticed another great marvel too: he touches the fire and is not burned, noble lady.

verses.text:
छन्देन चोदकं तस्य वहत्यावर्जितं द्रुतम् ।
अतीव चान्यत्सुमहदाश्चर्यं दृष्टवत्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Water flows swiftly to him when he wishes it, as he tilts the vessel. I saw yet another great marvel.

verses.text:
यत्स पुष्पाण्युपादाय हस्ताभ्यां ममृदे शनैः ।
मृद्यमानानि पाणिभ्यां तेन पुष्पाणि तान्यथ ॥

meaning.en: He took flowers and crushed them slowly in both hands, and as his hands crushed those flowers,

verses.text:
भूय एव सुगन्धीनि हृषितानि भवन्ति च ।
एतान्यद्भुतकल्पानि दृष्ट्वाहं द्रुतमागता ॥

meaning.en: they became even more fragrant and fresh. Having seen these wonders, I came back quickly.

verses.text: बृहदश्व उवाच

meaning.en: Brihadashva said:

verses.text:
दमयन्ती तु तच्छ्रुत्वा पुण्यश्लोकस्य चेष्टितम् ।
अमन्यत नलं प्राप्तं कर्मचेष्टाभिसूचितम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing about the doings of the man of holy fame, Damayanti took it that Nala had come, revealed by his actions.

verses.text:
सा शङ्कमाना भर्तारं नलं बाहुकरूपिणम् ।
केशिनीं श्लक्ष्णया वाचा रुदती पुनरब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Suspecting that her husband Nala was in the shape of Bahuka, she wept and spoke again to Keshini in a gentle voice.

verses.text:
पुनर्गच्छ प्रमत्तस्य बाहुकस्योपसंस्कृतम् ।
महानसाच्छृतं मांसं समादायैहि भामिनि ॥

meaning.en: Go again, and while Bahuka is off guard, bring some of the cooked meat from the kitchen, lady.

verses.text:
सा गत्वा बाहुके व्यग्रे तन्मांसमपकृष्य च ।
अत्युष्णमेव त्वरिता तत्क्षणं प्रियकारिणी ।
दमयन्त्यै ततः प्रादात्केशिनी कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Keshini went, and while Bahuka was occupied she took some of that meat, still very hot, and quickly brought it to Damayanti, as she was eager to please, O joy of the Kurus.

verses.text:
सोचिता नलसिद्धस्य मांसस्य बहुशः पुरा ।
प्राश्य मत्वा नलं सूदं प्राक्रोशद्भृशदुःखिता ॥

meaning.en: Damayanti had long been used to the meat that Nala cooked. She tasted it, concluded the cook was Nala, and cried out in deep distress.

verses.text:
वैक्लव्यं च परं गत्वा प्रक्षाल्य च मुखं ततः ।
मिथुनं प्रेषयामास केशिन्या सह भारत ॥

meaning.en: Overcome with agitation, she washed her face and sent her two children with Keshini, O Bharata.

verses.text:
इन्द्रसेनां सह भ्रात्रा समभिज्ञाय बाहुकः ।
अभिद्रुत्य ततो राजा परिष्वज्याङ्कमानयत् ॥

meaning.en: Bahuka recognised Indrasena with her brother, rushed to them, embraced them and drew them onto his lap.

verses.text:
बाहुकस्तु समासाद्य सुतौ सुरसुतोपमौ ।
भृशं दुःखपरीतात्मा सस्वरं प्ररुरोद ह ॥

meaning.en: Having got his two children, who looked like children of the gods, Bahuka, his heart overwhelmed with grief, wept aloud.

verses.text:
नैषधो दर्शयित्वा तु विकारमसकृत्तदा ।
उत्सृज्य सहसा पुत्रौ केशिनीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: The king of Nishadha, having shown his emotion many times over, suddenly let the children go and said this to Keshini.

verses.text:
इदं सुसदृशं भद्रे मिथुनं मम पुत्रयोः ।
ततो दृष्ट्वैव सहसा बाष्पमुत्सृष्टवानहम् ॥

meaning.en: Good lady, this pair is just like my own two children, and so, on seeing them, I suddenly shed tears.

verses.text:
बहुशः संपतन्तीं त्वां जनः शङ्केत दोषतः ।
वयं च देशातिथयो गच्छ भद्रे नमोऽस्तु ते ॥

meaning.en: If you keep coming here so often, people may suspect something wrong. We are guests in this land. Go, good lady, I bow to you.
